# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Create a document file.
3. Sign in to the inspection interface (Admin ➡ Building ➡ Accessibility).
4. Create a record.

   **Make sure to hit the green checkmark (✓) to save the record.**

   ## Tip:
   - Name the record in a consistent format!
   - Even if no work is immediately needed after inspection, still create a record for the failed check lets BMS staff know you have run the accessibility check and are aware of the failed areas.

5. When filing under the documentation requestable, organize the hundreds of buildings by district. (Event though the documentation requestable is alphabetized by building name.)

## Buildings that do not have a 5-yr accessibility assessment:
Enter street address into [this portal](https://www.example.com).

This should mark the accessibility areas. Then, take screenshots measuring in feet from INSIDE of the accessible door to
